title: ハルシオン・ウィングス：雲上の遺言を追いかけて
author: 天野 ソラ

en.title: Halcyon Wings: Chasing the Will Above the Clouds
en.premise: The underachieving young mechanic Kai stumbles upon the legendary ancient airship "Silver Gale." Inside, he discovers a mysterious will left by his missing father: "Go to the ice castle at the top of the world." With his best companions, he slices through the wind, racing toward the truth at the end of the cloud sea.

zh.title: 哈利修恩之翼：追逐云上遗言
zh.premise: 落榜的年轻机修工凯偶然发掘了传说中的古老飞船『银风号』。他在船上发现了失踪父亲留下的神秘遗言：‘前往世界之巅的冰城’。与最优秀的伙伴们一起，他切风而行，冲向云海尽头的真相。
